scenarios.description: Release 96 systemic control re-transformation completes across all entities with independent effectiveness evidence, material risk reduction and a stable 120-day sustainability window.
A repeatedly failing enterprise control remains degraded after re-transformation.
Implementation completes but systemic-risk reduction remains below the governed threshold.
One entity falls below the enterprise control-health threshold during sustainability observation.
An AI or worker attempts to accept residual risk, recertify recovery or reclose the enterprise program.
